info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在教導學生解決工程或應用科學中實際問題所需之相關微分方程式。課程內容涵蓋單元有一階常微分方程式、二階線性常微分方程式、齊次與非齊次微分方程式、偏微分方程式、微分方程組之觀念與求解。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces students to those areas of mathematics which are most important in connection with practical problems. Five topics are included in the course：(1)First-order ordinary differential equations; (2)Linear ordinary differential equations of second order; (3)Homogeneous and nonhomogeneous differential equations; (4)Basic concept of partial differential equations; (5) Systems of differential equations.
description.pre_subname: MATH1001微積分(一)、MATH1002微積分(二)、MATH1001P微積分(一)實習、MATH1002P微積分(二)實習
description.pre_sub_ename: MATH1001 CALCULUS(1)、MATH1002 CALCULUS(2)、MATH1001P RECITATION OF CALCULUS (1)、MATH1002P RECITATION OF CALCULUS (2)

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解何謂微分方程式，且能夠描述重要的微分方程式及其解法
targets.describe_en: Understand what differential equations are and be able to describe important differential equations and their solution methods.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解何謂拉普拉斯轉換及其在解微分方程式方面的應用
targets.describe_en: Understand what the Laplace transform is and its application for solving differential equations

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解何謂級數解法及其在解微分方程式方面的應用
targets.describe_en: Understand what the series solution methods are and their applications for solving differential equations

targets.describe_ch: 能將機械工程相關議題，以微分方程式表達並求解
targets.describe_en: Be able to formulate mechanical engineering related problems into Differential equations and then solve them
